children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Develop optional processes and shared safety libraries without weakening core operator, API, or agent boundaries.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Optional services remain opt-in and require independent least-privilege RBAC, bounded I/O, health, metrics, and secret-safe logs.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Each extension solves a narrow integration problem without becoming a mutation backdoor.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: audit-syslog-bridge relays authenticated audit JSON to syslog.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: telemetry-receiver accepts anonymous daily usage reports in a basic and an extended tier.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: mcp-server exposes strictly read-only Kubernetes diagnostics over stdio.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Put cross-component invariants in small modules only when multiple callers require the same protection.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: netguard protects outbound dials from SSRF.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: gameaction validates and renders module-declared commands.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Keep shared libraries narrow, deterministic, and heavily tested.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Maintain an independent module, tests, image, chart opt-in, health/metrics, bounded I/O, and synchronized release wiring.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  go test ./... inside the extension module

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Update Makefile + CI/release + chart values/templates together
